page.overview:
Who is Negaine?

Negaine is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She and Felaana Bevaine found Beonin Marinye wandering in Tar Valon and brought her to Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan when she asked to see the Amyrlin Seat.

Negaine and Maenadrin were surprised to see Egwene al'Vere in the Brown Ajah quarters very late at night. In reality, Egwene had been following her usual path to the novice quarters and was just as surprised to see the Brown sisters on reaching what she thought was her destination. This confusion was a result in a shift in the Pattern which had swapped the locations of part of the novice quarters with a portion of those belonging to the Brown Ajah.
